Subject: MAP proposal for Medico evaluation & proposed go-live cadence

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I attached a draft MAP (Medico-MAP-v2.xlsx) that lines up the evaluation milestones, acceptance gates, and procurement handoffs. High-level ask: can you confirm or update the target dates below so we can lock the Dedicated capacity and schedule the canary?

Proposed key milestones:
- Evaluation kickoff: 2025-06-09
- Midpoint checkpoint (performance/latency): 2025-06-23
- Security & procurement sign-off: 2025-07-07
- Staged canary: 2025-07-14
- Final acceptance / go-live: 2025-07-28

We called out contingency lanes in the MAP for procurement slippage (short-term reserved pool + temporary rate guarantees). If procurement needs more time, we can do a staggered acceptance where a subset of traffic goes live first (canary -> expanded acceptance).

Deliverables attached: Medico-MAP-v2.xlsx (milestones + owner matrix).

Next steps: if the dates above look right, reply with any blocked dates from procurement/legal and I’ll update the MAP and risk log.

Thanks —
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
p: (415) 555-0182

From: Elena Rivas <elena.rivas@medicohealth.com>

Date: 2025-06-02T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP proposal for Medico evaluation & proposed go-live cadence

Karthik —

Appreciate the map. Quick update from my side: procurement is running into an internal review of the contract template and our finance team flagged a required PO approval that likely pushes the procurement sign-off ~3 weeks later than your plan (we're looking at an earliest of 2025-07-28 now). Security has the SOC2 evidence request and should be fine — I attached the PO draft so you can see the timeline we shared internally (PO_tentative.pdf).

Two asks:
1) Can Redwood hold the proposed dedicated pool for a 3‑week window without committing us to the full term? We need a short hold/option while procurement clears.
2) If the sign-off moves to 07/28, can we stage acceptance so we don't lose the earlier performance validation window?

Happy to jump on a short call tomorrow if that's easier.

Best,
Elena Rivas
Senior Program Manager, Medico Health

Elena —

Thanks for the candid note. We're logging this as a schedule risk and I attached the current risk log extract (map_risk_log_20250603.csv) so you can see the mitigation lanes we can activate immediately. Short answers to your asks below.

1) Holding capacity: we can place a 3‑week reservation option on the Dedicated pool with a nominal option fee (waived for first week as a courtesy). That preserves throughput and prevents other allocations while procurement completes.

2) Staged acceptance: absolutely — proposed plan:
   - Keep evaluation kickoff on 2025-06-09 (performance testing environment remains available)
   - Run canary/instrumentation during the performance window (no production traffic)
   - If procurement sign-off completes before 07/14, promote canary to expanded acceptance; if not, keep canary and extend the acceptance gate to 07/28 with retained option on capacity.

I've escalated to our CSM and delivery leads (looping in Laura for executive approval on the capacity hold terms). If you want, we can draft a short amendment to the MAP that defines the "reservation option" and crediting schedule — that will make procurement comfortable.

Attaching: map_risk_log_20250603.csv (risk id R-112: procurement hold; mitigations: capacity option, partial go-live, credit schedule).

If acceptable, I'll prepare the short MAP amendment and a one-page exec escalation note for your procurement team.

Hi Elena / team —

Appreciate the update and the transparency on procurement timelines. We're prepared to activate the reservation option and formalize a short MAP amendment. Quick summary of actions we need to align on this week so we keep the evaluation momentum: 

1) Redwood actions (we'll do these once we get Elena's sign-off on the amendment language):
   - Place a 3‑week reservation on Dedicated pool for Medico (option fee: 1% of monthly commit; first week waived).
   - Prepare MAP amendment that codifies staged acceptance criteria and the credit schedule if procurement delay extends beyond 07/28.
   - Schedule a technical canary on 2025-06-24 to capture the performance baseline.

2) Medico actions:
   - Procurement to confirm PO earliest feasible date (Elena: can you confirm by EOD Tue 06/10?).
   - Security to confirm SOC2 artifact acceptance (anything outstanding we should ship?).

3) Escalation / exec path:
   - If procurement sign-off is not actionable by 06/17, we'll route an exec escalation (one‑page note) to finance and partnerships to approve a temporary credit/hold. I attached the draft escalation note (exec-escalation-note-20250604.txt) for visibility.

4) Communication cadence:
   - Weekly MAP sync (Thursdays 09:30 PT) until final acceptance.

Elena — please confirm you can respond to the procurement ask by 06/10 and whether we should send the MAP amendment directly to procurement or route it through your legal. We'll stand up the reservation option as soon as you authorize.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
